title: Surgical handover: routing + auth + quotas midweek briefing
content:
Purpose: quick midweek sync to do two surgical handovers: (1) routing hot fixes & feature flags; (2) auth token expiry backfill plan; (3) quota fallthrough simulation status. Fast cadence, actionable ownership, avoid long design discussions.

Attendees: Priya, Ethan, Liam, Jiao, Marisol, + guest: Anya (SRE) for observability notes.

1) Routing (Ethan)
- Status: rolling patch for route-matching edge case landed in canary (PR 876). Canary traffic at ~8% across us-west-2. Latency delta: +3ms p50 on burst tests, acceptable.
- Observed: a small class of header-injection requests still matched old prefix rule; added additional unit test and integration check.
- Blocker: one legacy customer (acct: redwood-int-qa) uses a nonstandard header set; need short fallback rule to avoid 502s.
- Decision: enable a temporary fallback that strips unknown headers before evaluation for that tenant only (feature flag: routing.strip-unknown-headers). Ethan to toggle by EOD if canary remains stable.
- Follow-up: Add a postmortem stub if fallback is enabled (owner: Ethan).

2) Auth (Jiao)
- Status: token rotation backfill plan ready. We need to rotate tokens for 3 service accounts where expiry metadata is missing.
- Approach: run two-phase backfill: (a) metadata scan job to surface affected services, (b) scheduled rotation window with gradual churn to avoid auth storms.
- Risk: sudden token churn for internal deployments could spike control-plane auth requests to IAM proxy. Mitigation: Jiao to coordinate with SRE (Anya) for rate-limiting policy and temporary queueing on the proxy.
- Action: Run metadata scan by 2027-11-11 (Jiao). Rotation windows scheduled 2027-11-15 -> 2027-11-17 (Jiao + Anya).

3) Quotas & Fallthrough Simulation (Marisol)
- Status: quota fallthrough lab results v2 attached in Confluence. Simulation shows a 7% increase in token cost when fallthrough tiers are allowed; 40% fewer 429s.
- Insight: For long-running small-burst customers, fallthrough to smaller quantized variants reduces tail latency but increases GPU token cost — tradeoff needs SLA mapping.
- Proposal: implement per-tenant cost-sensitivity flag (quota.fallthrough_policy = {strict, balanced, permissive}). Marisol to draft a short proposal and cost model by 2027-11-12.

4) Observability (Liam)
- Dashboard changes: added routing-rule breakdown by tenant and header-class; added auth-proxy queue depth visualization.
- Action: surface a daily digest to #pltfm-alerts for top-10 tenants by header-mismatch rate (Liam by 2027-11-10).

Blockers & Risks
- Risk A: If routing fallback is enabled without proper test coverage, we may accidentally mask malformed traffic vs malicious requests. Mitigation: put a short-lived audit log for stripped headers and run a threat scan (Ethan + Security).
- Risk B: Auth rotation could generate bursts to IAM proxy; SRE to add soft-throttle and circuit-breaker (Anya).
- Risk C: Quota fallthrough rollouts need billing communication with finance for cost-pass-through (Marisol -> finance).

Action Items (owner -> due)
- Ethan: Toggle routing.strip-unknown-headers flag in canary if no regressions observed -> 2027-11-09 EOD.
- Jiao: Run metadata scan job to enumerate affected service accounts -> 2027-11-11.
- Jiao + Anya: Coordinate rotation windows and SRE soft-throttle rules -> 2027-11-15 prep, full rotation 2027-11-17.
- Marisol: Draft quota.fallthrough_policy proposal + cost model + financing sync -> 2027-11-12.
- Liam: Add daily digest to #pltfm-alerts focusing on header-mismatch and auth-proxy queue -> 2027-11-10.
- Priya: Prepare a short customer note template in case routing fallback must be enabled for specific tenants -> 2027-11-10.

Decisions made
- Temporary tenant-scoped header-stripping fallback approved (owner: Ethan).
- Proceed with two-phase auth token rotation plan (owner: Jiao).
- Move forward with creating a quota policy abstraction (owner: Marisol) before any global fallthrough rollout.

Open questions
- Do we need an automated billing alert for tenants that cross the cost threshold when permissive fallthrough is active? (Marisol to propose)
- Should the header-strip fallback be visible in the Console routing debug panel? (UX/Console sync request opened)

Notes to reviewers
- This doc is concise by design; if you need fuller context see linked Confluence and PR 876.
- If you are on-call this week and see unexpected auth spikes, page Anya and add a line to the auth-rotation incident channel.

Meeting cadence: keep this midweek surgical handover for 6 weeks while we stabilize the routing and auth patches, then move to biweekly if stable.

Quick log (timeline)
- 2027-11-09 09:14: initial sync, canary reported +3ms p50.
- 2027-11-09 10:30: Ethan flagged tenant redwood-int-qa; created PLAT-1589.
- 2027-11-09 13:00: Jiao scheduled metadata scan.

End of notes.
